definition: Niki was an artificial intelligence company headquartered in Bangalore, Karnataka.
details: It was founded in May 2015 by IIT Kharagpur graduates Sachin Jaiswal, Keshav Prawasi, Shishir Modi, and Nitin Babel.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. That is Niki.ai — a small key that opens a big door.
